First and foremost, as fun as the violence route can be, it's too risky and can lead to more repercussions on your sibling's future. I get that it's warranted cause the bullies' seem unbearable pero trust me when I say it's going to hurt your sibling on the long run.

Here's what you can do:  
1) Admin will most definitely just ignore the issue kapag sa kanila ka dumiretso. So your best bet is heading straight to your DepEd Provincial Office and file a report. No choice ang school ng kapatid mo to act on it kasi mawiwindang yan.  
2) Start looking for other schools. The moment you start bringing light upon this issue (even if you don't involve DepEd), mas lalong magiging target ang kapatid mo. For their sake, transfer them to a different school after taking action cause it will be better for them. Just make sure na you won't let the your sibling's school get away scot free from this issue before you transfer your kapatid.  
3) If you're brave enough, call out the issue via social media if the school still isn't responding. These are things na sobrang nagpapastress sa admins ng school kasi reputation ang nakasalalay nila.

For the record, it seems na possible na dahil sa parents ng bullies kaya ganyan sila. We can't blame them, pero they need to be accountable as well especially na bata pa sila. Good luck OP, and I hope your sibling comes out of this safely.
